title.narrative: Funding of research on rural roads and transport services in Asia

description.narrative: This activity Funding of research on rural roads and transport services in Asia is a component of Improved Rural Roads and Transport Services for Communities in Low Income Countries. reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £4,924,218. This project benefits Asia, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Research/scientific institutions, Technological research and development, Road transport, Transport policy and administrative management.
